result.summary: Removes the unused `GetVirtualTransactionInputSize` helper function from policy code. It also removes the leftover references in the `tx_in` fuzz target and `wallet_tests`.

evidence: "The last non-test caller was removed in 9b7ec393b8 (#26567), when the wallet switched to estimating input sizes using descriptors." (commit message)

result.card: Removes the unused GetVirtualTransactionInputSize policy function along with its remaining calls in wallet tests and the tx_in fuzz target. The function became dead code when wallet input size estimation migrated to descriptors in PR #26567. It is a minor internal dead-code cleanup with no functional changes.
